additional_info.subject: Authentication Failure on Siemens Sicharge D Charging Station MP/R6 170002081 – Ticket Request and Troubleshooting Suggestions
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am contacting you to report a malfunction observed on two Siemens Sicharge D charging stations installed on our site. Please find below the detailed information:
Sicharge D 1: MP/R6 170002081
The driver reported being unable to authenticate. The screen displayed the following message:
“Authentication temporarily unavailable. Connection information could not be verified due to a technical issue. Please wait and try again.” (see attached photo).
I proceeded to reboot both charging stations on site. This had no effect on station MP/R6 170002081.
I then asked the driver to attempt to re-authenticate on the same station, but the issue persisted and authentication continued to fail.
I had to initiate the charging session remotely via the backend in order to allow the vehicle to charge.
Sicharge D 2: MP/R6 170002001
After reboot, this station appears to be functioning normally again. No further issue has been reported so far.
Could you please:
Open a support ticket for station MP/R6 170002081, and
Share your diagnosis or proposed resolutions to address the root cause and avoid recurrence of this issue?
Looking forward to your prompt response.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.
